what_its_for: Malathion is a medicated lotion used to treat head lice (tiny bugs that live on the scalp and hair). It works by killing lice and their eggs (nits) on your head.
how_to_take: This medicine goes ON your hair and scalp — do NOT swallow it. Here is how to use it: 1) Make sure your hair is dry before you start. 2) Apply enough lotion to fully wet your hair and scalp. 3) Gently rub the lotion into your hair from the roots to the ends. 4) Wash your hands right away after applying. 5) Let the lotion air-dry naturally — do NOT use a hair dryer, curling iron, or sit near any open flame while the lotion is in your hair because it CAN CATCH FIRE. 6) Leave the lotion on for 8 to 12 hours (overnight works well). 7) After the waiting time, wash your hair with plain shampoo (no conditioner), rinse well, and use a fine-tooth nit comb to remove dead lice and eggs.
dosing: Adults and children 6 years and older: Apply one treatment as described above. Check your hair after 7 to 9 days. If live lice are still found, apply a second treatment at that time. Do NOT use more than two treatments without talking to your doctor first.
missed_dose: Malathion is not taken on a daily schedule, so there is no 'missed dose' in the usual sense. If you forgot to do your second treatment check at 7 to 9 days, do it as soon as you remember. If it has been much longer and you still see live lice, talk to your doctor or pharmacist.
storage: Store the lotion at room temperature, away from heat and open flames. Keep it in a tightly closed bottle away from children. Do NOT store in the bathroom. Do NOT freeze. Throw away any unused lotion safely — do not pour it down the drain.
what_to_avoid: • Do NOT use a hair dryer, curling iron, flat iron, or go near open flames, stoves, or candles while the lotion is in your hair — it is FLAMMABLE. • Do NOT get the lotion in your eyes, mouth, or nose. If it gets in your eyes, rinse right away with plenty of water. • Do NOT use on children under 6 years old. • Avoid using on broken, cut, or irritated skin on your scalp. • Do NOT use extra amounts or apply more often than directed — more is not better and can be harmful. • Avoid contact with other people's hair while your lotion is on.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor right away if you notice: • Severe scalp irritation, burning, or redness that does not go away • Rash, hives, or signs of an allergic reaction (swelling of face, lips, or throat; trouble breathing) • Accidental swallowing — call Poison Control (1-800-222-1222) immediately • Eye irritation that does not clear up after rinsing • Trouble breathing or feeling dizzy after use • Lice are still present after two full treatments
when_it_works: Malathion starts killing lice very quickly after it is applied. You should see dead lice after the first treatment. Be sure to check again after 7 to 9 days to make sure all lice are gone. It may take two treatments for complete results. To help prevent spreading lice again, wash all clothing, bed linens, pillowcases, and towels in hot water and dry on high heat. Soak or replace combs and brushes.
special_populations: Children: Only use in children 6 years of age or older. Do NOT use in babies or young children under 6. Pregnancy and breastfeeding: Talk to your doctor before using if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, as it is not fully known how this medicine affects unborn babies or breast milk. Elderly: Use with caution; check with your doctor if you have any skin conditions. People with chemical sensitivities: Tell your doctor if you have had reactions to pesticides in the past.
